meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在每次对话前自动回忆之前存储的相关信息，并在每次对话后自动保存新的见解。记忆会持久保存，即使容器重启也不会丢失。
howto.when: 当使用 Claude Code 模式（--target claude-code）且代理组配置为 Claude 提供商时，每次容器启动和每次对话回合都会触发记忆的读取和存储。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次讨论的项目计划吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中调取之前对话中的项目计划信息。

say.text: 帮我记住这个 API 密钥的用途。
say.note: Claude 会在当前对话后存储这条信息，供以后回忆。

say.text: 之前我提到过哪些技术栈偏好？
say.note: Claude 会搜索记忆并给出之前记录的技术栈偏好。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memory persists across container restarts.
howto.when_en: When using Claude Code mode (--target claude-code) and the agent group is configured with Claude provider, memory recall and storage trigger on every container start and every conversation turn.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve the project plan from memory.

say_en.text: Remember the purpose of this API key for me.
say_en.note: Claude will store this information after the turn.

say_en.text: What tech stack preferences did I mention before?
say_en.note: Claude will search memory for previously recorded preferences.
